'''Trex''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in the employ of [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]], and the former [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and owner of the ''[[Krayt Fang]]'', a reddish-brown-colored [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was stolen from him by a group of adventurers while it was grounded for maintenance.<ref name="EfMS" />
